note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: five dated outbound air-cargo consignments from Delhi (INDEL4) to Seychelles, Mauritius, USA, Malaysia and Saudi Arabia between 24 and 28 Feb 2026, each with HS code and bill-of-lading number. Declared HS 330129 (essential oils, other) matches the actual dominant export code 33012924/33012990, so no HS correction is needed; note that the same consignments also carry 33011910, 33029011 and 15151990, i.e. the company ships a mixed essential-oil/oleoresin basket, not a single HS line. Domestic supply evidence could not be established: no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report split was retrievable — the web_search tool returned connection errors on all three attempts and volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403, so domestic_status is unknown rather than none_found (absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not proof of no domestic trade). Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the free views and are left null rather than estimated. Role appears to be manufacturer_trader of essential/herbal oils (aromatherapy grade), consistent with the claimed 'oil & gas / chemicals' industry; the buyer/supplier tables on the page mix unrelated consignees ('TO THE ORDER', APAR INDUSTRIES, TVS MOTOR) and should not be read as this company's own counterparties. No sanctions, litigation or registry status was assessed in this pass — out of scope for a shipments-evidence check.
